items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We were talking before about Napoleon and Chappardouas huh? You were playing at the wagon wheel like you were talking a long ago? Who was the drummer then? [INTERVIEWEE] The drummer then? Roy. Well Sean was playing at that time then.

ctx.x: After Roy, when after Sam left the band, the band stood up to say but after Sam got sick and couldn't play anymore, the band must have went, I'd say about a year or two years. First was quitting.
We were talking before about Napoleon and Chappardouas huh? You were playing at the wagon wheel like you were talking a long ago? Who was the drummer then?
The drummer then? Roy. Well Sean was playing at that time then.
